events.description: A circle of radius 2.5 is drawn by rotating a radial line 360 degrees, with a label '1' indicating the radius.
events.clip_query: A circle being drawn by a rotating radial line with a radius label of 1

events.description: A teal strip is introduced across the circle. Its width is dynamically tracked by a decimal number that changes as the strip shrinks and expands.
events.clip_query: A teal strip across a circle changing width with a dynamic decimal label

events.description: Three more strips of different colors (green, blue, light blue) and orientations are added to the circle, labeled d_2, d_3, and d_4.
events.clip_query: Multiple colored strips with labels d_1, d_2, d_3, d_4 covering a circle

events.description: Ten semi-transparent random strips cover the circle, and the labels d_1 through d_n fly to the top of the screen to form a summation expression.
events.clip_query: Many semi-transparent strips covering a circle and their width labels summing up at the top of the screen
